name: ToyTools
description: ToyTools is the internet's little toolbox: free, browser-based tools for text, numbers, developer utilities, productivity, money, generators, physics, applied math, chemistry, dates, health, design, music, fidgets, prep, and games. The prep tools prepare text before a model (ToyTools does not run a model). The text, files and values you enter in tools are processed on your device and not uploaded. The site uses analytics, and the feedback form sends what you submit.
